prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1157; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented after a rear-end motor vehicle collision and was seen on three occasions for neck pain consistent with whiplash. The reported severity of symptoms seems out of step with the low-energy impact described at the scene, and the mechanism alone would not ordinarily account for the degree of complaint recorded. Treatment followed a typical course of conservative care, including manual therapy and a home exercise program, and was tapered as symptoms gradually eased. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm a soft-tissue injury to the cervical region. The patient reports no prior injury to the neck or upper back, and none is found in available records. Billing for the episode reflects single, non-duplicated charges for each visit and the imaging study. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise, and the patient is advised to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological signs appear.
